data.revised_prompt: A high-quality 3D chibi-style school app avatar portrait of a fictional Chinese girl student aged 8-14, designed as a simple centered icon asset with bold silhouette, minimal detail, high contrast, and readable at small sizes. Square 1:1 composition, tightly focused on the head, front view or slight three-quarter view, complete hair outline visible, face and hair together occupy 75%-85% of the canvas, with only a very small amount of shoulders and neck visible at the bottom. Clearly a student, not an adult, not a teacher. One character only. Hair: half-up high ponytail with natural wispy bangs, tied with a small red bow. Expression: gentle, reserved smile. Eyes: bright warm brown eyes, polished but soft 3D modeling, soft studio lighting, refined educational app character style. Clothing: only a tiny visible white school collar at the bottom, no badge, no text. Background: fully filled edge-to-edge with a low-saturation rose pink color, no white borders, no transparent areas, no circular frame, no halo, no scene, no gradients that leave corners empty. Emphasize strong distinction visible at 48px. No half-body, no upper body, no full body, no hands, no gestures, no props, no adults, no earbuds, no headphones, no suit, no heavy makeup, no jewelry, no top-of-head cut off, no hair cut off, no chin cut off, no small face, no off-center subject, no large shoulders, no white background, no circular avatar frame, no ring, no glow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no school emblem, no logo, no watermark, no multiple characters, no photorealism, no flat 2D illustration, no infant proportions, no dark tone, no low resolution, no distorted facial features.
